name: select
label: Select
description: Determines what happens when the user clicks on a button. "single": users can only select one button from the group at a time. "multi": users can select multiple buttons from the group simultaneously

name: items
label: Button options
description: An array of objects, each with the configuration for a button

name: variant
label: Variant
description: Color and behavior of the button

name: hideButtonLabel
label: Hide button labels
description: Select to hide labels for all buttons. The button displays without a label when an icon is provided

name: bare
label: Hide container
description: Removes the border around the container

name: fixedWidth
label: Button fixed width
description: If set to true, all buttons have the same width. The longest text string defines the width for each segment

name: selectedItems
label: Selected buttons
description: An array of IDs representing selected buttons

name: manageSelectedItems
label: Manage selected items
description: Enable this property to override automatic updates to the selected items property. Use the selected items set event to intercept the requested change and handle it manually

name: minWidth
label: Button min width
description: Sets the minimum width of the button. Value must have units

name: label
label: Group label
description: Label describing the overall purpose of the button group

name: labelPosition
label: Label position
description: Position of the group label around the button group

name: highContrast
label: High contrast
description: Sets the style to increase the contrast when a button is displayed on a colored background
